title: Grades of a resume against the posting's asks (work/grades_before.json, work/grades_after.json)

grades.description: One entry per ask in jd_asks.json, using the same ids

grade.description: clear: a line proves it; weak: hinted or only listed in Skills; none: not shown

evidence.description: The resume line that proves it, quoted, or why it is weak or missing

risks.description: Claims an interviewer will probe (hiring-manager agent, tuned resume only)

risk.description: How hard it would be to back up in the room

slop_score.description: Reads as if the candidate wrote it (10 = fully)
